scripts.build:backend: npx -w backend-nest prisma format && npx -w backend-nest prisma generate && npx -w backend-nest nest build
scripts.start:backend: npm install -w backend-nest && npm run build -w backend-nest && npm run start:dev -w backend-nest
scripts.start:frontend: npm install -w frontend-next && npm run dev -w frontend-next
scripts.start: npm run build:lib && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm:start:backend" "npm:start:frontend"
